_comment: Curator profiles, keyed chainId -> lowercased address -> profile.
Per-chain keying is REQUIRED, not cosmetic: 0x18e1eec9... curates
'Wrapped Re7 RWA Yield' on Plume but 'Wrapped UltraYield ctUSD Prime' on
Citrea. A flat address->profile map would collide on that address.
`role` records where the address was observed on-chain. Only 6 of 26 vaults
set a non-zero curator(); for the rest the owner is the de-facto curator, so
the gateway matches on curator first and falls back to owner.
`confidence` is how the name was established:
high   - vault name carries the brand unambiguously, or the address is
corroborated across two or more vaults / chains
medium - single vault, brand readable from the name
low    - internal/test deployment or unnamed vault; name is a placeholder
`image` is null everywhere and `url` is set only where the operator is
publicly known - neither can be derived from on-chain data. Fill them in
before relying on them in the UI.
